_meta.description: recipe uuid -> CraftingType uuid, extracted from the APK's RecipeData._recipeMap (each RecipeActionMapping pairs a UidCraftingTypePointer with the RecipeList whose recipes belong to it). Nothing here is authored: a recipe absent from this table is absent from the shipped client data.
_meta.outputSource: Recipe._outputs[]._itemTemplate (RecipeOutput has no other serialized field, so quantity is the constant 1). Absent for Tempering / Repairing / Salvaging (no _outputs — they mutate the input item) and for Enchanting (outputs are item PROPERTIES, _itemTemplate is null).
